integrity: Finite comparisons use exact integer and rational arithmetic, not floating-point evidence. The first-public date is the arXiv v1 posting date. Same-model review has been performed; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns exactly the two Fibonacci–Lucas weight sequences and the finite-sum normalization of arXiv:2609.33564v1. It makes no assertion for odd degrees or other recurrence weights. The infinite range \(N\ge26\) uses Proposition 7 after reconstruction of its proof; the new bridge \(14\le N\le24\) is certified by exact rational arithmetic.
title: The sharp \(N=14\) threshold for the largest Fibonacci–Lucas zeta-sum term
